text: SELECT player_id, player_name, SUM(pts) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT game_id) AS games_played FROM "nba_golden"."dev"."player_game_stats" WHERE game_date >= '2030-01-01' AND game_date < '2031-01-01' AND player_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_id, player_name ORDER BY total_points DESC, player_name ASC LIMIT 10
